integrity.finite_verification: Exhaustive finite Python checks for square fibers of orders 2, 3, 4 and ternary teams of order 2.
integrity.infinite_claim_basis: Self-contained analytic argument in RESULT.md; finite checks are not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Bernoulli membership on ordinary relational teams, not numerical probabilistic-team independence.
Critical laws concern equal domain sizes; exact finite formula covers arbitrary sorted finite sizes.
No convergence claimed for arbitrary sequences without the stated normalization limits.
The equiprobable count follows from established rectangular-fiber semantics and is not claimed as novel.
The full 2023 dimension paper was not obtained; equivalent random-database formulations remain an originality risk.
title: Two Poisson windows for conditional independence in random finite teams
